name: Philip
source:
The reliable older brother type, he works as a dealer at the Lurunia casino.
He's good at dealing with things and people like him easily, he seems to be luckier than most people.
He's a quick wit and the most accomplished of the dealers at the casino. He often works past his shift.
He can be a little cranky at the end of a night shift.
